description:
The image showcases a pair of wooden skis leaning against a stone wall, accompanied by a walking stick. The skis are propped up against a fence or wall made of stone blocks, in front of a building. The skis appear to of been well used, with a brownish-red color and a few scratches and scuffs on the wood surface.

In the background, a building with a reddish-orange roof and beige walls is visible, featuring several windows adorned with shutters and balconies
